vision.name: Vegeta's Final Flash
vision.text:
[Attack] 3: Energy attack.
This attack can only be stopped by an Energy Combat card. Raise your anger 2. Players can only attack or pass in their actions this combat.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: You may lower your MP 1 level. If you do, your opponent discards a random card from their hand.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: grey card; possessive title -> Named; stage cost printed as '3:'; disclaimer line mentions 'Dragon Ball Daima'; no Endurance badge
